concerns.text: Task T016 implements a 'Fixed-Effects GLS' model and explicitly claims to 'avoid random intercepts', directly contradicting FR-005 and Plan Phase 6 which mandate a 'linear mixed-model' (LMM) with random effects to account for gene-specific variance. This is a semantic weakening of the statistical requirement.

Task T013c logic ('if motif_validated... else if hic_validated... else exclude') implements an exclusive OR or sequential filter, violating FR-014 which requires an inclusive OR ('motif overlap... OR evidence of chromatin looping'). The task description implies excluding CREs that have Hi-C evidence but no motif, or vice versa, if the logic isn't strictly 'OR'.

FR-003 requires a sensitivity sweep reporting 'downstream β₁ estimates' for each FDR threshold (0.01, 0.05, 0.10). The current task split only extracts top CREs and computes overlaps; there is no task to re-run the mixed-model (or GLS) analysis on the peak sets derived from the 0.01 and 0.10 thresholds to generate the required β₁ estimates for the sweep report.

Task T026 compares 'full set (post-FR-014)' against 'filtered set (post-VIF)'. FR-017 requires comparing the 'full set of CREs' (pre-filter) against the 'filtered set (post-FR-014)' to quantify selection bias introduced by the validation filter. The task compares two different filtering stages, failing to measure the specific bias defined in the spec.

FR-003 specifies sorting top-20 CREs by 'adjusted p-value (primary) and absolute β₁ magnitude (tie-breaker)'. Task T007b1 mentions sorting by these two fields but fails to explicitly define the 'tie-breaker' logic, risking non-deterministic ordering if p-values are identical, which violates the strict sorting requirement for the overlap calculation.
